# smartupsell

> Post-purchase upsell software for Hungarian e-commerce. Increase cart value with one-click offers shown on the order confirmation page.

smartupsell helps webshops increase revenue by displaying targeted product offers after checkout. Customers can add items with a single click without re-entering payment details. Average acceptance rate: 4.76%, average cart value increase: 1,746 Ft per upsell.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://smartupsell.hu): Main landing page with product overview, key metrics, and signup.
- [Services](https://smartupsell.hu/services): One-click upsells, cart-based targeting, FOMO timers, OTO offers, analytics.
- [Pricing](https://smartupsell.hu/pricing): Revenue-based pricing with 30-day free trial.
- [About](https://smartupsell.hu/about): Team information and company background since 2012.
- [Story](https://smartupsell.hu/sztori): The smartupsell origin story, methodology, and why post-purchase upsells work.
- [Testimonials](https://smartupsell.hu/testimonials): Customer success stories from rmekszer.hu, mediaplaza.eu, dermaonline.hu, kerekparguru.hu.
